entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Um, yes. I... I have an item I need to return, I think. I'm just so confused by the website. It's a jersey.
I can certainly help you with that. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's just the wrong size. My sister got it for me for Christmas, but it's much too tight. I can barely get it on. I think I need to do an exchange, but I don't know how.
Not a problem at all, we can definitely look into that for you. Do you have the order number or the email address it was purchased under?
Yes, she gave it to me. Hold on... It's VF88602-1. Is that right? I get all these numbers mixed up.
VF88602-1. Perfect, thank you. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the order here for the Pro-Vent Jersey. It looks like it was delivered on December 12th, about 26 days ago.
Oh dear, is that too long? I've been so busy I didn't get to it. Can't you just help me? I would be so grateful.
No need to worry. Let me just check our policy for you. One moment... Yes, for a standard item like this jersey, you are well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process this for you.
Oh, thank goodness! So you can help me exchange it for a bigger size?

Yes, absolutely. Since you'd like to do an exchange for the same item in a different size, I can start that process for you right now. I'll email you a pre-paid shipping label to send back the jersey that's too tight, and once we see it's in transit, we'll ship out the new size to you. Does that work?
That's wonderful! Thank you so much, Isaac. You've made this so much easier.
You're very welcome. I'm happy I could help. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
